protocol.sampling: Native API defaults; no temperature/top_p/top_k or effort override
protocol.input_policy: Exact same 70 audited prompts and 28 case mappings as the local Gemma pilot; no format tuning
protocol.pilot_gate: All pilot attempts return expected model and complete usage with end_turn or max_tokens; actual eligible cache read and write observed; truncations and unparseable answers retained as invalid votes. No accuracy filter.
protocol.cache_policy: Explicit final text block, five-minute TTL, sequential repeats; prompts shorter than 512 provider tokens cannot cache
protocol.primary_contrast: Split minus Huber majority-vote accuracy on 28 matched cases; parent-cluster descriptive uncertainty
protocol.secondary: Original, stable changed, joint, false restoration, per-condition and per-class outcomes; exact and lattice controls; per-repeat stability
protocol.voting: Three final attempts per unique prompt; end_turn valid labels vote, token-limit and unparseable responses are invalid; majority among valid votes, ties first encountered, all-invalid incorrect; retain superseded first truncation and both charges.
protocol.retry_policy: One observed 8192-token truncation retained in prior_attempts and rerun at 16384; all subsequent requests use 16384. No automatic error, timeout or further truncation retries.
protocol.budget_guard: Before every generation reserve 1.10*(counted_input_tokens+128)*5m_write_rate + 16384*output_rate; reported spend plus uncertain and in-flight reserves must remain <=35 USD
